perturbation.label: Move target object
perturbation.description: Moves the object to pick up by value cm in a random direction on the table. The core generalization test: does Dream-1 look where the object is, or replay a memorized motion?

strategies.label: Full chunk (48)
strategies.description: Executes all 48 planned steps (2.4 s) before asking Dream-1 again. Default behaviour.

strategies.label: Receding horizon (24)
strategies.description: Asks every 24 steps (1.2 s) and executes only the start of each new plan. Reacts faster, but every new plan may start somewhere else. ~2× the requests.

strategies.label: Crossfade (30)
strategies.description: Asks every 30 steps (1.5 s) and fades the arm joints from the previous plan to the new one over those steps (the gripper follows the new plan). No seam jumps, fully on the new plan after 1.5 s. ~2× the requests.

verdict.text: Crossfade (30) wins: 6/12 successes vs 0/12 with the default — significant (paired McNemar p = 0.03, 6 of 12 pairs disagree) · seams 57% smaller, arms 15% faster, 1.4× the API requests. Smoothest motion: Receding horizon (24) (jitter −13%, seams −36% vs the default, independent of speed).
